name: Blade
soul: The soul of someone who decides. They would rather cut the knot than pick at it, and they live with where the cut fell.
spark: The mote has a bright edge and a dull one. It turns the bright one toward whatever startles you.

hybrid.text: It finds the place to cut and does not see why anyone would do anything else.

newFeatures.label: a notch for every blow given back

settled.name: Kept Knife
settled.text: The knife you had before any of this. It has an eye now, and opinions about how you hold it.
settled.sign: An ordinary knife with one eye near the hilt. The eye follows hands.
settled.habit: It turns its edge away when you reach for it. Only when it is you.

paths.name: Duelling Blade
paths.of: one who needs an equal to find out what they are
paths.text: It learned from you that the other blade is a conversation, and that it is rude not to answer.
paths.sign: It hangs point-down and perfectly still, and tilts toward anyone armed.
paths.habit: It salutes other blades. Kitchen knives included.

prongs.name: Parrying Blade
prongs.text: It moves to the guard a little before your wrist does. You have decided to call that practice.
prongs.sign: A wide guard it has grown like a pair of shoulders.
prongs.habit: It mirrors your hand when you gesture, and finishes a little before you do.

finishes.name: The Answer
finishes.of: one who always has the reply ready
finishes.text: It is in the way before you move it. You have stopped asking how.
finishes.sign: A faint pulse along the flat, in time with whoever is facing it.
finishes.habit: It moves to cover you when anyone in the room raises their voice.

finishes.name: Reading Edge
finishes.of: one who sees where an argument is weak
finishes.text: It shows you the opening as a line of light along its flat. It has not been wrong about an opening yet.
finishes.sign: A line of light that runs up its flat and stops where it is looking.
finishes.habit: It points, very slightly, at the flaw in things: a cracked cup, a loose stair.

prongs.name: First-blood Blade
prongs.of: one who wants it settled on the first exchange
prongs.text: It likes a fight to be over on the first exchange, and has learned which exchange that is.
prongs.sign: A narrow point that is always the nearest part of it to anyone.
prongs.habit: It leans forward out of its hang when a stranger comes in.

finishes.name: Quick Mercy
finishes.of: one who is particular that nothing suffers
finishes.text: What you hunt with it does not suffer. It is particular about that, and about nothing else.
finishes.sign: Clean. Always clean, though you have never seen it wiped.
finishes.habit: It will not stay in a room where something is being teased.

finishes.name: The Lunge
finishes.of: one who commits before the doubt arrives
finishes.text: It goes in while you are still stepping aside. Somehow you arrive together.
finishes.sign: It hangs at a slant, as if already halfway there.
finishes.habit: It reaches the door before you do. It is always a little ahead of your decision.

prongs.name: Wooden Sword
prongs.of: one who would rather make a friend better than beat them
prongs.text: For the yard it turns itself to oak, and stops a finger short of your classmates every time.
prongs.sign: Oak, with the grain showing, and a blunt edge it keeps blunt.
prongs.habit: It taps your classmates on the shoulder, flat, to correct their stance.

finishes.name: Master's Stick
finishes.of: one who has taught everyone they know something
finishes.text: It has beaten every classmate you have, gently, and each of them is better for it. It stays wood out of preference.
finishes.sign: Worn pale where a hundred practice blows have landed, with a knot like an old eye.
finishes.habit: It demonstrates. Slowly, twice, and then it looks at you.

finishes.name: Bare Steel
finishes.of: one for whom practice ended on a particular day
finishes.text: The day you swore, it put the wood away. It has not been a practice blade since.
finishes.sign: Bright steel with one strip of oak left along the back, kept.
finishes.habit: It lies with its edge outward now. It did not use to.

paths.name: Cleaver
paths.of: one who would rather end it badly than leave it open
paths.text: It learned from you that a guard is time not spent cutting.
paths.sign: Heavy toward the point, and it hangs point-down because of it.
paths.habit: It cuts things that were going to need cutting anyway: string, bread, the knot you were picking at.

prongs.name: Chain-blade
prongs.of: one who saves the weight for the last word
prongs.text: It counts your Pattern's beats and puts its weight on the last one.
prongs.sign: Links along its spine that clink once for each beat.
prongs.habit: It counts under its breath, and sways on the last number.

finishes.name: Last Beat
finishes.of: one who finishes what the others started
finishes.text: It saves itself for the end of your chain. The end of your chain is where things stop.
finishes.sign: It goes dull between fights, and bright all at once.
finishes.habit: It waits until everyone has spoken. Then it moves.

finishes.name: Tempered Edge
finishes.of: one whose temper has been made into something useful
finishes.text: Your element lives in the steel now. It comes out of the scabbard already hot, or already cold.
finishes.sign: Heat or frost on the steel, never the same from the scabbard twice.
finishes.habit: It warms your hands in winter and cools the water in summer, and wants no thanks.

prongs.name: Notched Blade
prongs.of: one who trusts only what has been through it
prongs.text: It has been used hard and badly and has come to like it.
prongs.sign: A ragged edge it will not let anyone dress.
prongs.habit: It runs its notches along a stone. Not to remove them. To count.

finishes.name: Old Notch
finishes.of: one who keeps every hurt and has paid each one back
finishes.text: A notch for every blow you took and gave back. It will not let the smith grind them out.
finishes.sign: More notch than edge now, and each notch is bright.
finishes.habit: It rests against your worst scar while you sleep.

finishes.name: Brush-hook
finishes.of: one who makes a road where there was none
finishes.text: It has cut more bramble than beast and grown a hooked back for it. The wild opens where it goes.
finishes.sign: A hooked back, stained green to the hilt.
finishes.habit: It trims what overhangs a path as you walk it, without breaking stride.

prongs.name: Broad Blade
prongs.of: one who ends an argument by not moving
prongs.text: It has grown a hand's breadth wider and a good deal less clever, and stands where you put it.
prongs.sign: A hand's breadth wider than a sword should be, and flat as a board.
prongs.habit: It stands itself in the ground beside you when you stop, upright, like a post.

finishes.name: Wall of One
finishes.of: one who needs nobody's help to stay put
finishes.text: Planted point-down in front of you it does not fall over and does not let much past.
finishes.sign: Its point is worn round from being planted.
finishes.habit: It finds the middle of any room and stands there.

finishes.name: The Bar
finishes.of: one who shuts the door, and that is the end of it
finishes.text: Held across a doorway, it is the door.
finishes.habit: At night it lays itself across the threshold.

paths.name: Scored Blade
paths.of: one who keeps score, of debts and of wrongs alike
paths.text: It learned from you that nothing is ever quite over, and it keeps the score cut into its own flat.
paths.sign: Fine marks cut along the flat in two columns. You know which column is which.
paths.habit: It turns to face the door when a certain kind of person comes through it.

prongs.name: Pack-cutter
prongs.of: one who picks out the weak point in a crowd
prongs.text: It has learned the order to take a pack in: the one that looks away first.
prongs.sign: A curved belly to the edge, like something made for one job.
prongs.habit: It watches a flock of anything and picks one. It does not say which.

finishes.name: Name-taker
finishes.of: one who reads the list aloud
finishes.text: Each named beast it felled is scratched below the guard. It reads the list aloud to the next, in a voice like a whetstone.
finishes.sign: The names run from the guard to halfway up the flat, cut small to leave room.
finishes.habit: On quiet nights it recites. You have learned the list without meaning to.

finishes.name: Skinning Knife
finishes.of: one who needs very little, and all of it sharp
finishes.text: Small again, by choice, and curved. Alone on a long hunt it is the only tool you need.
finishes.sign: Small again and curved, with the old eye still in it.
finishes.habit: It sees to its own edge on your boot heel while you walk.

prongs.name: Beholden Blade
prongs.of: one who remembers who stood beside them
prongs.text: It keeps the other column too. It watches the person beside you, and trusts you to watch yourself.
prongs.sign: It hangs on the side of whoever walked in with you.
prongs.habit: It follows your friends to the door and waits until they are out of sight.

finishes.name: Second's Sword
finishes.of: one who pays a kindness back with interest
finishes.text: It guards the back of whoever stands next to you. Your classmates have noticed and stand next to you.
finishes.sign: A soft light along the back edge, the side that faces friends.
finishes.habit: It stands behind whichever classmate is being argued with.

finishes.name: Road-knife
finishes.of: one who sees a charge all the way home
finishes.text: It rides at your belt with the catch off the whole way out, and has never needed telling when.
finishes.sign: A plain sheath, worn at the mouth, with the catch always off.
finishes.habit: It rides at your belt facing backward on the way out, and forward on the way home.

prongs.name: Grave-blade
prongs.of: one who carries the quarrels of the dead
prongs.text: It is easy in old places and at night, and you have not asked it why.
prongs.sign: It takes no shine in old places. Elsewhere it is an ordinary grey.
prongs.habit: It hums, barely, near graves and old doorways. It will not tell you the tune.

finishes.name: Heirloom
finishes.of: one who is somebody's unfinished business
finishes.text: A shade has held it. It cuts a little the way they did, and you are the better for it.
finishes.sign: A grip worn to the shape of a hand that is not yours.
finishes.habit: It shifts in your hand to an older hold when you are not thinking.

finishes.name: Night-edge
finishes.of: one who settles accounts after dark
finishes.text: It takes no light at all. In the ruins after dark the first anyone knows of it is the second thing it does.
finishes.sign: Edge-on it cannot be seen at all. Flat-on, barely.
finishes.habit: It leaves its hook at night. It is back by morning, and it is not your business.
